verifiedFacts.claim: Wikipedia states that “Sunday Morning” was the final song recorded for the album and that Tom Wilson requested another potential single with lead vocals by Nico.

sourceRefs.extract: In late 1966, "Sunday Morning" was the final song to be recorded for The Velvet Underground & Nico. It was requested by Tom Wilson, who thought the album needed another song with lead vocals by Nico with the potential to be a successful single.
